scope: Versioned public-source catalog and upgrade queue. This file does not bundle unreviewed candidate data or grant a spatial registration.
policySummary: Only public digital sources with stable access records may enter the acquisition queue. Public availability is not permission to re-bundle or to call an author-space coordinate a project registration.

sources.title: BrainGlobe allen_cord_20um 3.0

provenance.primaryCitation: Fiederling et al. 2021; BrainGlobe Atlas API

rights.note: BrainGlobe AWS source is CC0; the upstream SC_atlas_P56 record is CC BY 4.0. Keep both attribution records with every derivative.

content.spinalCoverage: reference volume, not a cell census

sources.admissibleUse: Pinned local reference anatomy and sampled display planes.
prohibitedClaims: A sampled plane is not an observed specimen.
The reference alone does not register a cell, SWC, or evidence entity.
Atlas AP position is not a curated named spinal segment in this release.
nextChecks: Preserve the source and derivative manifests
Keep display transforms separate from registration transforms

sources.title: NeuroMorpho.Org adult mouse spinal-interneuron exemplars

rights.note: CC BY 4.0 plus repository terms. Cite the original reconstruction paper, NeuroMorpho.Org RRID, and Tecuatl et al.

sources.admissibleUse: Topology-QC-checked morphology examples in their reported local frames.
prohibitedClaims: A local SWC frame is not an atlas coordinate frame.
Five examples are not representative of all interneurons.
Morphology does not establish a synaptic edge list.
nextChecks: Use the official API for metadata
Require source-specific QC before adding each additional SWC

sources.title: SpinalJ processed example data

rights.note: The catalog permits metadata audit only until file-level reuse and derivative decisions are recorded.

content.spinalCoverage: example dataset with source-specific section series

sources.admissibleUse: Reproducible registration-engineering benchmark using released processed outputs before any raw multi-gigabyte acquisition.
prohibitedClaims: A benchmark transform does not register the current evidence entities.
A successful visual overlay is not validation.
Do not transfer the transform to NeuroMorpho SWCs.
nextChecks: Inventory files, dimensions, spacing, orientation, checksums and transform provenance
Hold out landmarks before any REG proposal

sources.title: Cano-Gomez et al. mouse spinal-cord spatial and multiomic resource

rights.note: Accession availability does not settle derivative distribution rights or identify a project-space transform.

content.spinalCoverage: cervical, thoracic, lumbar and sacral study-specific samples

sources.admissibleUse: Condition-bounded source-local observations after specimen, pixel-size, orientation and cross-modality-key audit.
prohibitedClaims: This preprint is not a project registration by default.
Author-space coordinates are not the BrainGlobe coordinate space without a validated transform.
Do not call a cross-study label transfer a same-cell multimodal observation.
nextChecks: Audit stable specimen IDs and coordinate metadata
Require independent held-out error before proposing REG

sources.title: Russ et al. harmonized mouse spinal-cord cell-type atlas

rights.note: Record the exact processed object, license and download checksum before any derived marker table is bundled.

content.lifeStage: postnatal reference with adult spatial validation context
content.spinalCoverage: type-level atlas; not per-cell spatial registration

sources.admissibleUse: Marker and taxonomy crosswalks with developmental and adult evidence kept as separate conditions.
prohibitedClaims: A molecular cluster is not an individual cell xyz position.
Postnatal taxonomy does not silently become adult geometry.
Marker overlap does not establish a unique circuit family.
nextChecks: Document label-transfer confidence and unresolved mappings

sources.title: Tabulae Paralytica spinal-cord injury atlas

rights.note: Start with processed accession records. File-level rights, sample metadata and checksum are required before bundling.

content.spinalCoverage: model- and condition-bounded, including mid-thoracic injury contexts

sources.admissibleUse: Explicit injury-, time-, severity-, sex-, drug- and model-bounded state evidence.
prohibitedClaims: A Visium spot is not one interneuron.
Mid-thoracic injury data do not represent C1-S3.
Cross-condition averages must not erase injury-model differences.
nextChecks: Select a processed subset with full condition metadata
Model a spot or aggregate separately from cell-level observations

upgradeQueue.title: SpinalJ registration reproducibility benchmark
upgradeQueue.deliverable: A source-local reproducibility report with native spacing, transforms, landmark split, held-out error and no transferred cell registration.
acceptanceCriteria: Processed inputs and checksums are pinned
Training and held-out landmarks are disjoint
Physical-space error is calculated and reported
upgradeQueue.rejectIf: The data lack a reproducible transform, landmarks, or file-level reuse basis.
upgradeQueue.scientificBoundary: A successful benchmark does not convert current SYN entities or OBS-local SWCs into REG.

upgradeQueue.title: Cano-Gomez source-local spatial adapter audit
upgradeQueue.deliverable: Specimen-aware source inventory recording pixel scale, orientation, coordinate origin, cell IDs, modality links, terms and missing transform information.
acceptanceCriteria: Every displayed object retains a specimen ID
Coordinate units and orientation are explicit
upgradeQueue.rejectIf: The release lacks stable cross-modality keys or reproducible coordinate provenance.
upgradeQueue.scientificBoundary: Remain source-local OBS or author-space results until independent registration validation passes.

upgradeQueue.title: Molecular taxonomy crosswalk
upgradeQueue.deliverable: A version-pinned marker and label crosswalk that keeps lineage, transmitter, molecular identity and projection class as separate axes.
acceptanceCriteria: Input object and checksum are recorded
Developmental context is not collapsed into adult geometry
upgradeQueue.rejectIf: A label transfer is presented as a unique identity or coordinate.
upgradeQueue.scientificBoundary: This is type-level molecular evidence, not a spatial registration.

upgradeQueue.title: Injury-state condition adapter
upgradeQueue.deliverable: Condition-specific injury records with model, level, severity, time, sex, treatment, modality and aggregation level.
acceptanceCriteria: All conditions retain their original model metadata
Spot-level and cell-level records have different schemas
Null and boundary information are retained
upgradeQueue.rejectIf: The adapter pools incompatible injury models or labels a spot as an interneuron.
upgradeQueue.scientificBoundary: No C1-S3 generalization or same-cell linkage follows from this adapter.

upgradeQueue.title: NeuroMorpho phenotype-stratified expansion
upgradeQueue.deliverable: A larger, source-stratified SWC set with topology QC, source-paper linkage, reconstruction completeness fields and local-frame disclosure.
acceptanceCriteria: Every SWC passes topology and checksum checks
Original-study and repository citations are retained
Missing axon and tissue-processing fields remain explicit
upgradeQueue.rejectIf: Source-local coordinates are visually placed into the atlas without a validated transform.
upgradeQueue.scientificBoundary: Expansion improves morphology coverage only; it does not make a representative census or connectome.

upgradeQueue.title: Public-source release-admission service
upgradeQueue.deliverable: A deterministic intake manifest generator that records source URL, access date, license, object IDs, file hashes, coordinate space and release decision before source data enters a build.
acceptanceCriteria: No unpinned remote asset enters a package
A failed rights or provenance check blocks bundling
Generated audit output is exportable for curator review
upgradeQueue.rejectIf: The service silently downloads, transforms or republishes data without an explicit asset-level decision.
upgradeQueue.scientificBoundary: Automation can document evidence; it cannot certify biological validity or curator approval.
